# Is In View Angle

Source: [4660](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4660); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Is In View Angle](../../api/values/is-in-view-angle.md).

<a id="wiki-4660-n1"></a>

- Is In View Angle ignores map geometry/LOS and measures direction from the player's feet rather than eye position.

<a id="wiki-4660-n2"></a>

- Equivalent test compares Angle Between Vectors(Direction Towards(Position Of(player),target),Facing Direction Of(player)) with the degree threshold.
